dct_description_sm: "Lith. of W. Boell ... Phil." Includes explanatory letter dated Aug. 24, 1863 from T. Detterline to Benjamin Wrigley. Maps show troop positions, roads, railroads, rivers and names of residents. This item is in the Map Collection of the Library of Virginia; please contact the Library's Archives Research Services department for more information. Two of the maps are sketches furnished by "Genl. J.R. [i.e. I.R.] Trimble"; one furnished to Benj. Wrigley and one furnished to J.C. Frey. Two of the maps are sketched by "Detterline Gettysburg." Available also through the Library of Congress web site as raster image. Oct. 2002; source unknown (1969); Map Cataloging Team. Civil War Map Proj. no.: LVA00066. Conservation: Etherington Conservation Center, July, 2002. Digital image available: 22.5 x 18.25 in. Map accession no.: 2876 (1969). Previously filed as: 748.42 M6 1861-1865 [1863?].
Available also through the Library of Congress web site as raster image.
Civil War Map Proj. no.: LVA00066.
Contributors: Boell, William.; Detterline, T.; Frey, J. C.; Trimble, Isaac, 1802-1888.; Wrigley, Benjamin.
